scope: Design intent only. Geometry checks, sewing decisions and physical fitting remain separate.
retention_definition: Back waist takeout divided by back takeout at zero waist ease, with the same body and hip ease.
angle_definition: Largest outward hip-to-hem chord angle across the two side edges and four princess edges, measured from vertical construction geometry before front dart rotation.
source: User approved separate fitted/relaxed families, 75% retained shaping and a 45 degree maximum flare chord.
